ARCHITECTURAL GAP, confirmed by inspecting intel_adjust.py: the adjustments fence (MULT_FIELDS = xg90/xa90/xgi90/cbit90/cbirt90, SET_FIELDS = stp) only mutates a PLAYER's own row, keyed on player+team.
